programme.title: Peter Bell 2: The Czar Crown
programme.desc: Pietje Bell is jailed for theft but escapes to prove his innocence. He battles crime boss Stark and, with his gang, tries to stop a daring crown heist.

programme.title: Where Is Kyra
programme.desc: Where Is Kyra? follows Kyra Johnson, a middle-aged woman who moves back in with her ailing mother after losing her job and going through a difficult divorce. As her financial situation worsens, Kyra begins making risky choices to survive while trying to maintain a sense of stability and dignity. Her relationship with a mysterious man brings temporary comfort, but her growing desperation leads her into a dark and uncertain path. The film explores loneliness, economic struggle, identity, and the emotional impact of hardship.

programme.title: Drive Hard
programme.desc: A former race car driver is abducted by a mysterious thief and forced to be the wheel-man for a crime that puts them both in the sights of the cops and the mob.

programme.title: Love Or Death
programme.desc: Love Or Death

programme.title: Legendary Voyages
programme.desc: Legendary Voyages

programme.title: Homewrecker
programme.desc: Two women befriend each other, but one becomes obsessed with the other.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.

programme.title: Fire Twister
programme.desc: A man-made fire twister sweeps through Los Angeles, leaving the city in ruins. However, all is not lost when a group of strangers band together to put an end to the destruction.

programme.title: Full Out 2: You Got This!
programme.desc: When the University of Oklahoma Sooners lose their star gymnast, Brenna Dowell, the rest of the team have to find a way to believe in themselves in order to win their second National Gymnastics Championship. With the help of Riley, a local breakdancing phenomenon, Chayse and her OU teammates learn to incorporate intricate breakdance techniques into their gymnastics routines in order to find a competitive edge. At the end of it all, they realize what matters most is finding the confidence to believe in yourself.

programme.title: Where Eskimos Live
programme.desc: Sharkey, part of the sinister world of child trade, picks up Vlado, an orphan of war, dreaming of freedom and a better life. They embark upon a strange and enlightening journey through war torn Bosnia. As they struggle to get out of the country and fight to stay alive, they find a special love and compassion from which emerges their ultimate moral and spiritual redemption.

programme.title: The Thin Line
programme.desc: An aimless beauty looks to break her cycle of dating bad men by going after one she can't stand in the first place.

programme.title: Hero Dog: The Journey Home
programme.desc: When unexpected circumstances separate a loyal dog from its owners, an extraordinary adventure begins. Determined to find the way home, the dog navigates rugged landscapes, encounters both danger and kindness, and discovers the true meaning of courage, friendship, and perseverance. Filled with heartfelt moments and inspiring encounters, Hero Dog: The Journey Home is a touching family adventure celebrating the unbreakable bond between humans and their canine companions.

programme.title: Legendary Voyages
programme.desc: Legendary Voyages

programme.title: Mad Genius
programme.desc: Mason Wells, a gifted but unconventional programmer, creates a groundbreaking device capable of connecting human minds within a shared subconscious world. As the technology attracts the attention of influential figures with hidden agendas, Mason finds himself caught in a dangerous struggle where reality becomes increasingly uncertain. Combining science fiction, psychological suspense, and philosophical questions about consciousness and free will, Mad Genius explores the consequences of innovation when imagination and reality collide.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.

programme.title: Viking Quest
programme.desc: A young peasant boy is taken from his home by Viking raiders and raised as one of them. But when a legendary dragon attacks his clan, he discovers that he is the Viking hero destined to stop the dragons from destroying the world.

programme.title: Before The Fire
programme.desc: When a global pandemic forces a TV actress to escape to her rural hometown, an intruder from her past proves as dangerous as the encroaching virus.

programme.title: Human Traces
programme.desc: Working to restore the ecosystem of an isolated Sub-Antarctic island, Glenn and Sarah live far removed from civilization until the arrival of an enigmatic young man disrupts their quiet existence. As communication with the outside world is cut off, hidden truths, mistrust, and emotional tensions surface, turning the research station into a place of uncertainty and psychological conflict. Set against the stark beauty of New Zealand's remote landscapes, Human Traces is an atmospheric thriller exploring isolation, guilt, and the complexities of human nature.

programme.title: Merry Ex Mas
programme.desc: Merry Ex-Mas follows divorced couple Chad and Kate, who unexpectedly find themselves spending the Christmas holiday together. Despite their separation, family responsibilities and holiday circumstances bring them back into each other's lives. As they revisit old memories and confront the reasons behind their breakup, they begin to question whether their relationship truly belongs in the past or if there is still a chance for reconciliation. Filled with humor, romance, and heartfelt moments, the film explores love, forgiveness, and second chances.

programme.title: A Walk In The Woods
programme.desc: After spending two decades in England, Bill Bryson returns to the U.S., where he decides the best way to connect with his homeland is to hike the Appalachian Trail with one of his oldest friends, Stephen Katz.

programme.title: Daughter For Sale
programme.desc: Daughter for Sale follows Rachel, a mother whose teenage daughter disappears under mysterious circumstances. Determined to find her child, Rachel begins investigating the events leading up to the disappearance and discovers a disturbing network involving exploitation and human trafficking. As she gets closer to the truth, Rachel must confront dangerous individuals and race against time to rescue her daughter while uncovering the dark secrets behind the crime.

programme.title: A Shine Of Rainbows
programme.desc: A lonely orphan's life is transformed by an extraordinary woman who teaches him to conquer grief and discover the magic in nature and himself.

programme.title: Undisputed 2: Last Man Standing

programme.title: Per Tutta La Vita
programme.desc: Four married couples find out that their marriage is not valid because celebrated by a man that was not a real priest. The four stories intertwine and the couples find themselves having to decide what to do next, get married again or not.

programme.title: Pokémon The Movie: White
